# Metastable_State_Probing

**Domain**: iNEST
**First mentioned**: auto-extracted
**Last updated**: 2026-08-04

## Definition
A technique for systematically identifying and characterizing long-lived, non-equilibrium configurations in complex dynamical systems. Enables the detection of stable computational states in neuromorphic circuits, critical for reliable information storage and processing in noisy, energy-efficient hardware.
